Pearson r ignores the scale of the predictions, but the penalty changes which genes drive them, so it should change the score.

A lot of drug sensitivity follows cell lineage, and right now the model can only learn it indirectly from 5,000 heavily shrunk gene coefficients. This change adds an explicit lineage step: for each drug, take the mean AUC of each OncotreeLineage on the training lines, using only measured values and shrinking small lineages toward the overall mean. The same ridge is then fitted to whatever that leaves unexplained, with unmeasured AUCs set to 0 instead of the drug mean.
